elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 20(k) requires Garman to maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 20(k) requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 20(k) requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 20(k) requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 where Garman processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Sparkling, which operatively addresses processing of Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 20(k) expressly requires workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

elements.element: Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: Section 20(k) expressly states that Garman shall provide certificates of insurance on request.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 professional liability limit exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback limit.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires USD 5,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance when Garman processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Sparkling, exceeding the USD 2,000,000 fallback limit.

result.reason: The added paragraph supplies every preferred insurance coverage, limit, conditional trigger, and certificate obligation. It therefore also exceeds both fallback limits. The amendment is confined to the requested insurance covenant and does not alter or contradict the existing entire-agreement provision or other unrelated commercial terms.
